docs.title: rn-forge-devops
docs.text:
rn-forge-devops is CI and release automation for rn-forge repositories in any language, run with uv.

The rn-forge-devops command reads a repository's workspace manifests, selects the packages a change affects, prints every CI job's matrix, and gates each package's release on its checks. A workflow file keeps only its platform's constructs and calls the command.

It is built from four modules:

  • rn_forge.devops.ci, the core: the member graph, change selection, check matrices and release gating. It knows neither the CI platform nor the stack.
  • rn_forge.devops.uv, the uv workspace adapter: it reads the [tool.uv.workspace] members, their internal requirements and their [tool.workspace-ci] tables into the core's graph, and runs smoke.
  • rn_forge.devops.github, the GitHub Actions adapter: it writes $GITHUB_OUTPUT lines and reads the event context.
  • rn_forge.devops.cli, the console script that wires the subcommands to the core and the adapters.

The package depends on packaging and no other rn-forge package. The core imports neither adapter; uv run lint-imports proves both rules. The facade re-exports the core only.

Use the reference for the subcommands and the API.

docs.title: Changelog
docs.text: Notable changes to rn-forge-devops, newest first, in the Keep a Changelog format.

docs.title: Changed
docs.text: • A package with no [tool.workspace-ci.smoke] table is still smoke-tested: plan lists its empty-extra smoke entry, releasable requires its <name>.smoke marker, and smoke imports the package's own module.

docs.title: Added
docs.text:
• The rn-forge-devops package: CI and release automation for rn-forge repositories in any language, run with uv. It holds the workspace planner that was .github/scripts/workspace_ci.py, split into a core (rn_forge.devops.ci), a uv workspace adapter (rn_forge.devops.uv), a GitHub Actions adapter (rn_forge.devops.github) and the rn-forge-devops console script (rn_forge.devops.cli).
  • The adapters subcommand and the adapters key of [tool.workspace-ci]: a package lists its adapter names, and the command fails when a name has no module or no extra of the same name, or is repeated.

docs.title: rn_forge.devops.ci
docs.text:
The CI core: the member graph, change selection, check matrices and release gating.

The core knows neither a CI platform nor a package manager. An adapter fills a Workspace from the repository's own manifests and formats the plan outputs for its platform.

docs.title: plan(workspace, base)
docs.text:
Return every job's matrix and package list for a run against base.

Command-line values are shell-quoted strings. The keys are release-order, packages, postgres, smoke, suites, pytest-args, cov-args, test-paths, sonar-sources, sonar-tests, sonar and docs.

docs.title: releasable(packages, ok_dir, names)
docs.text:
Return the packages of names that may be released, then those that may not.

A package may be released when every check of it left a marker file in ok_dir and its requirements among names may be released too. Both lists are in release order.

docs.title: select(workspace, base)
docs.text:
Return the packages with changed files, plus every package that depends on one.

An empty, invalid or non-ancestor base, or a change outside every package and UNSCOPED, selects all. A base is invalid unless it matches REVISION.

docs.title: Subcommands
docs.text:
Run rn-forge-devops from inside a uv workspace. Its root is the nearest directory at or above the current one whose pyproject.toml declares [tool.uv.workspace].

Subcommand Does plan [BASE] Selects the packages a change affects, and writes every job's matrix and package list as $GITHUB_OUTPUT lines. releasable OK_DIR NAME... Prints, in dependency order, the selected packages whose checks all passed and whose selected prerequisites are releasable. released Prints name dir module version for each <name>-v<version> tag at HEAD, for external-install and docs. smoke PACKAGE [EXTRA] Builds the package and its internal requirements as wheels, installs one extra into a clean venv from the wheels' metadata, and imports the configured modules, or the package's own module when it has no smoke table. adapters Checks each package that declares adapters: every name has a module or subpackage under the package's source directory and an extra of the same name, and none is repeated. Prints one line per problem to stderr and exits 1 if there are any. sonar-target Prints the branch-arg= line for the Sonar scan, from the EVENT_NAME, REF_TYPE and REF_NAME environment variables.

docs.title: What it discovers
docs.text:
• Packages: the members of the root [tool.uv.workspace], including exclude. No name prefix is assumed.
  • Internal requirements: workspace members named in a package's dependencies, optional dependencies and dependency groups.
  • Import name: [tool.uv.build-backend].module-name, used for --cov, the external-install import and the smoke imports.
  • Optional jobs: sonar runs only if sonar-project.properties exists; docs only if mkdocs.yml exists.

An empty, invalid or non-ancestor BASE selects every package. A change under docs/ selects no package; any other change outside the members selects every package.

docs.title: What a repository declares
docs.text: Table Where Holds [tool.workspace-ci] root pytest-args for package test runs. [tool.workspace-ci.suites] root A named workspace-wide pytest run per key, each its own job. [tool.workspace-ci.postgres] package env: the variable that receives a PostgreSQL DSN; the package's tests run again against a service container. [tool.workspace-ci.smoke] package Optional: a package without it is still smoke-tested with no extra, importing its own module. modules imported for every smoke run, an optional setup script run first, and extras: one smoke job per extra with its own modules. [tool.workspace-ci] package adapters: the names of the package's adapter modules. Each must be a module or subpackage of the package and have an extra of the same name; adapters checks it.

docs.title: The plan outputs
docs.text:
Generated CI workflows read the plan outputs. A removed or renamed key, or a changed row shape, is a breaking change and takes a major version bump. A new key or a new row field is a minor change.

Each output is one key=value line. A string is written as is; a list or a boolean is written as JSON. "Selected" packages are the packages the change affects plus every package that depends on one, in release order. "Every" means every workspace member, whatever the change.

Key Value Scope release-order List of package names. Selected packages List of rows {name, dir}. Selected postgres List of rows {name, dir, env}, one per package that declares a PostgreSQL run. env is the variable that receives the DSN. Selected smoke List of rows {name, extra, marker}, one per smoke check. extra is empty for the run with no extra. marker is the file name a passing check leaves for releasable. Selected suites List of rows {name, args}, one per [tool.workspace-ci.suites] key. args is a shell-quoted string. Every suite pytest-args Shell-quoted string of the root pytest-args; empty if none. Workspace cov-args Shell-quoted string of one --cov=<module> per package. Every test-paths Shell-quoted string of the package directories. Every sonar-sources Comma-separated <dir>/src paths. Every sonar-tests Comma-separated <dir>/tests paths, for packages that have a tests directory. Every sonar true if sonar-project.properties exists at the root, else false. Workspace docs true if mkdocs.yml exists at the root, else false. Workspace

sonar and docs report only that the file exists; neither is scoped to the change.

The current kiln workflow no longer reads sonar-sources, sonar-tests, cov-args and test-paths; kiln takes Sonar sources from sonar-project.properties. They are still emitted.

docs.title: rn_forge.devops.uv
docs.text:
The uv workspace adapter: manifest reading and the smoke and adapters checks.

Members are those of the root [tool.uv.workspace]. A member's internal requirements are the members named in its dependencies, optional dependencies and dependency groups. CI settings live in [tool.workspace-ci] tables: the root one holds workspace-wide settings, a member's own holds that member's extra checks.

docs.title: adapter_problems(package, extras, modules)
docs.text:
Return one message per problem with the adapters package declares.

A declared adapter is a problem when it is repeated, when it is not in modules, or when it is not in extras.

Parameters:

Name Type Description Default package Package

The member; one that declares no adapters has no problems.

required extras set[str]

The names in the member's [project.optional-dependencies].

required modules set[str]

The module and subpackage names found in the member's source directory.

required

docs.text: Return the problems adapter_problems finds across the workspace members that declare adapters.

docs.title: smoke(workspace, package_name, extra)
docs.text:
Install package_name with only extra from wheels built from this checkout into a clean venv, then import the modules its [tool.workspace-ci.smoke] lists, or the package's own module when it declares none.

The install uses exactly what the wheels declare, so an extra that omits a dependency another extra brings fails here. An empty extra installs the package with no extra.

Returns:

Type Description int

The exit status of the import step.
